title: feat: label Bee Census responses
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- The Bee Census form now applies the `BEE-CENSUS` label to every response (label created; the 8 existing responses are backfilled).
- The issue organizer skips `BEE-CENSUS` issues, like `APP-SUBMISSION`, so survey answers no longer get AI kind/priority labels or land on the Dev project board.
- Lists `BEE-CENSUS` among the workflow labels in `AGENTS.md`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The bees have been counted
gist.blurb: Bee Census answers now get their own label and stay out of the development queue. The eight early responses got counted too.
gist.summary: The Bee Census form now labels every response `BEE-CENSUS`, backfills the eight existing responses, and keeps those issues out of AI kind/priority labeling and the Dev project board.
gist.impact: Survey responses remain available under `BEE-CENSUS` without being treated as development tasks.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a friendly census taker sorting eight survey cards into a lime-green BEE-CENSUS basket beside a separate development board; flowers and code-plants make the sorting desk feel like a small garden office.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden office, Polli wears a tiny census-taker cap and sorts eight survey cards into a basket marked 'BEE-CENSUS,' away from a retro development board, with flowers and code-plants nearby.
